title: SRD: Ready lets a creature wait for a trigger and act with its Reaction; engine: no Ready action, readied trigger or readied Reaction exists

history.summary:
Added the Ready action (GLOSS.ready). 
- combat.py: Combat.readied plus a Readied record (trigger creature, distance, response, release, held Concentration). ready() checks the turn and that the action is free (new Combat.require_action, which spend() now reuses), checks the trigger, builds the response, then spends the action. A refused response costs nothing. readied_attack and readied_move build the responses; a readied move is checked against Speed when readied (R-20). _readied_triggers runs after any move: only the chosen creature moving to within the distance triggers it. With no Reaction left, this is logged and nobody is asked. Otherwise the readier is asked `readied`. Ignoring keeps the response (R-18); taking it spends the Reaction and releases it right away. A refused release keeps both. attack() gained reaction=True, so a readied attack doesn't spend the action. start_turn and end_combat drop the readied response (#2). A held spell's Concentration ends at the start of the readier's next turn and the slot isn't refunded (R-19). An on_concentration_end hook makes a held spell dissipate when Concentration breaks (#9). 
- spells.py: cast(ready=True) refuses spells whose casting time isn't an action (#7). It casts as normal (slot and components spent, no action spent) and holds the energy under Concentration "<Spell> (readied)" (#8, R-17). It returns the Casting with release(game), which ends the holding Concentration and applies the effect through the new _take_effect helper. The 'no implementation' OutOfScope check now runs before anything is paid. 
- api.py: cmd_ready parses {trigger: moves_within, response: one command}. Lists are refused ('one', R-20), Bonus Action commands are refused (R-20), and other actions or triggers are OutOfScope. cmd_cast's argument handling moved into _cast so it can be reused. 
Results: all 31 T-41 tests pass with --runxfail. The unit suite and ruff are clean, dev-gate passes, and in the full run the only failures are the 31 T-41 strict-xfail XPASSes.
